ambiguities: Opportunities restricted to pbp rows whose game_id is a kept game; posteam present checked before code replacement (OAK/SD/STL -> LV/LAC/LA).
Opportunity season/date taken from games.csv (the game's), not pbp season column.
Missing yardline_100 -> yb=4; missing down -> dg=0; td indicator = (pass_touchdown==1) / (rush_touchdown==1), missing -> 0.
Cell model fitted for every season 2010..2026; REF seasons max(2010,S-3)..max(2010,S-1) inclusive (S=2010 and S=2011 both use 2010 only).
EWM is index-based (per item, not per calendar time), computed by recursion W_i = 0.5^(1/6) W_{i-1} + z_i, mathematically equal to the stated sum.
Player state is per player across all teams (not per player-team); when several player-games share one date, the state after the last one in (date, game_id, T) order is used.
Club state over all team slots of kept games from 2010 on (z=0 if no opportunity rows); same-date ties use the last in (date, game_id) order.
L_share and K computed over season S-1 where S = the row game's season; K uses all team slots of S-1 (including any with z=0).
prev = T's last 4 kept games (any season, from 2010) dated strictly before d; q = the latest date of the player's player-games for T among those prev games.
Team slots with no prior games (no prev) produce no rows; rows only for kept games with season >= 2013.
Cross-team conflict: larger q wins, tie -> alphabetically smaller team code (post-replacement). 61 conflicts resolved.
Output team column holds player id; pteam is not written since the Output section lists only 5 columns. Rows sorted by (game_id, team).
